metadata.non_finite_policy: JSON null with an adjacent *_status field; identical-image PSNR has explicit positive_infinity_identical status.
metadata.timing_note: Preview and batch timing scopes are recorded in their sections; verification and final JSON writing are not workload timings.

denoising.reference_note: Synthetic added-noise recovery; source images are not assumed clean ground truth.
denoising.noise_note: 5% distinct selected V positions; some may already equal the assigned 0/255 value.
denoising.aggregation: Unweighted arithmetic statistics across images; infinite PSNR excluded and counted separately.

enhancement.aggregation_note: std_v is spatial pixel spread within one image; *_across_images.std is spread between images.
enhancement.interpretation: An increase in Mean V or Std V alone does not establish better visual quality. mo_nhe is not treated as low contrast.

preview.resize_note: Same aspect-ratio/no-upscale/positive-rounding rule as frontend; OpenCV INTER_AREA is not bit-identical to browser Canvas resampling.

timing_scope.preview_processing_ms: enhance_image including histograms + encode_rgb_to_jpeg_base64; excludes decode, resize and input JPEG preparation.
timing_scope.preview_response_ms: Local TestClient POST, including multipart, decode, validation, pipeline, output encoding and response serialization; excludes network, browser and client response.json().
timing_scope.api_reported_processing_ms: processing_time_ms returned by the same API call, rounded by the existing route to 0.01 ms.

batch.timing_scope: Full-resolution disk read/decode -> production pipeline -> encode/write. Parallel includes pool startup/shutdown and task IPC. Excludes output-directory setup, verification, upload, polling and ZIP.
batch.cache_note: Alternating mode order between rounds; OS file caches are not flushed. No batch pool warm-up; every parallel run creates a fresh spawn pool.

summary.speedup_interpretation: sequential_mean / parallel_mean; values below 1 mean parallel is slower
